steps.content: In the interrogation room, a flowerpot with a wisteria branch planted in it sits on the Sinner's seat.
The scene before you is completely out of the ordinary, but you've already accepted it. Resigned, you water the branch generously, then settle into your chair and gradually drift off to sleep.
Yingying has made herself comfortable, curling up in the interrogation room's chair.

This place remains an illusion created by the wisteria branch, much like the DisCity she attempted to recreate before. Even this interrogation room is a space Yingying crafted in her own fantasy, tailored to her own taste.
In reality, you and Yingying are indeed also in the interrogation room, but just as a wisteria branch and a person fast asleep.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So, in the end, you still have to interrogate me...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no helping it. Your crimes were too blatant.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You broke into the suite of an important diplomat, took the leader of the delegation away without permission, and ultimately caused his death... It also doesn't help that Mr. Wei's status is so special. So, I'll need answers.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh, that girl from Eastia. I remember her. She's always trying to take me back.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Now, what would you do, sweetheart? Are you feeling so apologetic that you plan to hand me over as compensation?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's a separate matter, but we do need to have a serious talk.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you've told me before, but I need to ask you again.
You fall silent for a moment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Mmm... Because he made a wish to me.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you might have noticed. When I first met him, I felt a massive surge of Mania power. It was all because his wish was so intense that it infected me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So it wasn't because of the Eastian soil he gave you?
She pouts.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Do you think I'm some kind of vegetable?
Then, her gaze softens.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Though the familiar Eastian accent did comfort me, true recovery comes from the spirit... the Qi... or the soul of a human.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Normally, the power of mortal wishes shouldn't be enough to rouse me, but his wish wasn't a sudden impulse or fleeting desire... It was a devoted longing he'd held onto every minute, every moment for decades without ceasing.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: That's why I was able to move, but there wasn't much time. I had to find him quickly.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: His yearning was powerful enough to wake me, yet so weak it could barely sustain his own flickering life.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: On his deathbed, he longed to go back in time, to find his beloved, to fulfill a promise long broken.

options: But the wish wasn't made to you.

choices.text: But the wish wasn't made to you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Ah, so you've noticed too, sweetheart.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: He was 119 years old. Back when I was still holding the fete, he was only five. Way too young to be grabbing a girl's hand and swearing eternal love, right?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I'm afraid his memory might be playing tricks on him... Fetes like that were quite common back then. Perhaps it was another flower fairy enshrined at some other temple.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: He was almost 120... At such an age, wealth and status no longer matter, responsibilities can finally be set aside, and even past wisdom fades away. He could no longer remember when he made his wish, where he wanted to go, or to which deity he prayed.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: He just heard a rumor about some wish-granting flower fairy appearing. Not caring whether it was true, he rushed all the way here just to fulfill a promise he had made.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: He had even forgotten that his beloved hadn't simply gone astray... she had long passed from this world. That promise... was already lost so many years ago.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Yet despite everything, he still remembered the one person he longed to see.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: When he entrusted his final moments to me, everything else in his mind had grown hazy, yet his memory of Youlan remained crystal clear.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Perhaps he held onto life for so long just for the chance to see her one last time? While not every wish can come true, the power of a wish can still sometimes create small miracles.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So when his wish came true, he could finally find peace and let go.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I... I understand him deeply. Looking at him is like looking at myself.

She lowers her eyes and falls into silence. After the fete, she often unconsciously wears this expression. When the Wisteria Fairy's bright smile fades, her eyes reveal such profound, heartbreaking loneliness.
...This look on her always makes you hesitate. But... you know you have to ask.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That you both pine for the old Eastia? That you both have overcome disasters for your beloved, refusing to forget for decades?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or... that those dearest to you are gone and there's nothing left to hold onto... Do you wish to go with them too?
She meets your gaze, pondering your words. As she becomes lost in thought, her eyes grow distant.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You're right. I've been wondering too. Why didn't I leave with everyone else back then? Why did I stay behind...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Staying in a place where I know no one, can't speak the language, can't adapt to this foreign land, my body constantly ailing... What good has it done...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: My lifelong wish has already come true, so why can't I... pass on peacefully like Mr. Wei did...
Her voice grows fainter with each word, yet her words fall upon your heart with an ever-increasing weight.
The interrogation room falls silent. Breathing grows heavy and labored as your thoughts race wildly through your mind. Every cell in your body feels like it's sinking, and each second stretches on.
After what feels like an eternity, you finally force yourself to speak.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even though this isn't your homeland, and after a century later, this world isn't as beautiful as before... but as you've seen, it's not all that bad either.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I cherish this world deeply, and I want to show you all the endearing parts that make it worth cherishing. Just as you once told me...
Is she looking at you? You don't know. The weight of your emotions is too heavy to bear, forcing you to bow your head, unable to meet her gaze.
Speaking those words has drained every ounce of your strength.
But you must tell her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I hope you can move past the pain of your past and find new hope when you look to the future. I hope you can find happiness again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I don't want this to become your chain. I don't want to force you to stay in a place that... can't make you happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are free, Yingying. The only thing I wish for is your happiness.
[Transition] 2s

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Pfft... Hahaha, I called you dense before, but you really are completely clueless!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Didn't I stay because some big clueless idiot kept me from leaving?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, are you joking around again? I'm being serious here. Do you know how much courage it took me to...
Before you can finish, she rises from the interrogation chair with a laugh and closes the distance between you. Her sweet perfume envelops you like a garden in full bloom.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hmm? Are you really made of stone? Or are you just playing coy? Must I spell it all out for you, sweetheart?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I might have to dig into you to see what's really in there...
She leans in with a smile, bringing her lips to your ear, her voice turning soft and gentle.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Staying alive hasn't been easy for me. It's as hard as the long journey was to Mr. Wei. But I've persevered through it all.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: For the sake of those who loved me, my neighbors, my family, I've endured countless disasters and endless cycles of suffering, all in the hope of finding peace.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But when salvation finally came, I couldn't reach it in time.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: With nothing else to lean on and everything from my past gone, I thought I had nothing left. But when I turned around, someone was there, holding my hand.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Perhaps that was when a new sprout grew in my heart again, and a new wish took root.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Would you... help make this one come true?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I want to... always stay by your side.
Her gaze grows tender, clear and deep like still waters.
You find yourself at a loss for words. After a long pause, you speak.

options: ...You're not just playing along to humor me again, are you?

choices.text: ...You're not just playing along to humor me again, are you?

steps.content: She shakes her head without a word, but her eyes shine with such brightness. Her cheeks flush pink as she breaks into a radiant smile, the liveliest you've seen her since your first meeting.

Like the sun shining through storm clouds, all the worry, guilt, reluctance, and sorrow weighing on your heart suddenly vanish. As you look at this person who has a painful past and an unclear future, all that comes to mind is that...
Thank goodness, spring has finally returned to her.

options: ...What about Eastia then? Do you still want to go back?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's your homeland, and the place that could heal you. You're not going back? ...Don't you miss it?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Mmm... Of course I do. I want to see what flowers bloom in that land after the wisteria withered, how people live now, what kind of wishes they make.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Mr. Wei mentioned that people are still holding fetes even after the disaster. I'd love to go back and see them.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But... I'll have to take you with me. Otherwise, you'd be worried sick. You wouldn't want to let me go because you're afraid that I might wander off and never return... Right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I guess I'll need to apply for my annual leave then.
Her smile grows even brighter.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Just as wisteria needs a tree to survive, I once relied on the illusions of New Year fetes. But from now on, I'll rely on you instead, twining myself tightly around you.

options: Get off me first, then we'll talk.

choices.text: Get off me first, then we'll talk.

steps.content: Without you noticing, she has wrapped herself around your neck. ...Of course, this is all an illusion she created after all.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since we've agreed I'm not going back to Eastia, I'll just have to depend entirely on you, sweetheart.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I can wait for you to get stronger before taking your Qi again, but for now... at least give me your heart.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You're a rational person, so you rarely make wishes. That's why I can't hear your heart's desires or receive power from your prayers.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But I want to know your deepest longing, your wishes, your true self, and your determination. I want to know everything about you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh? Do tell...

options: I want Yingying to get better soon.
I hope we can always be together.

choices.text: I want Yingying to get better soon.
I hope we can always be together.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hehe, then we'll both have to work hard, so we can be together forever.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Always be together.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Remember your wish now. Remember me.

A few days later, Yingying met again with the Hengyun Hall delegation from Eastia led by Wei Ziyi.

Thanks to the farewell letter Mr. Wei left in the paper crane, Wei Ziyi doesn't give Yingying too much trouble and agrees to let Yingying stay in DisCity for now. They'll also arrange to supply her with soil and water from Eastia through import channels.

Hengyun Hall also signs a special aid agreement with DisCity, agreeing to cover all restoration costs and subsequent compensation for damages caused by the wisteria calamity and the fete. They also purchase the land closest to the wisteria remains at a high price.

Delighted to have found such a generous benefactor, DisCity's upper echelons quickly green-light everything. Hengyun Hall officially establishes their presence in DisCity, maintaining close contact with Wuhuanzi, the wandering herbalist from Eastia.
Of course, none of this matters right now to the MBCC's Chief, who's too busy snoring away in the office.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Zzz... Zzz...
On his desk, the wisteria branch has sprouted new buds. Someone is watching him through the tender leaves.
steps.female_content: On her desk, the wisteria branch has sprouted new buds. Someone is watching her through the tender leaves.

steps.content: You're a mind reader, sweetheart. You always see through people's smiles and unveil their hidden thoughts.
Yet your own mind is so easily stirred. All it takes is a little Eastian-style sweet talk to make you blush. You even forgot to question me thoroughly.
Still sleeping. Must be exhausted from work, huh? Yingying's heart aches at the sight. She reaches out, and a gentle breeze caresses ${PlayerName}'s hair in her stead.
Then, she raises her head, her gaze piercing through the impenetrable walls toward distant horizons.
My sorrow isn't from being bound to you. Nor am I hiding any desire for liberation.
Unease wafts through the city winds as sunlight is slowly distorted... Something stirs in the depths beneath your feet.
...I know this feeling too well. Even after a hundred years, though its form has changed, I still recognize it.
That star is lurking near. It's awakening.
Ethereal floral vines rise from the ground, gently enveloping ${PlayerName}'s body.
From this moment on, even if the rivers boil and the mountains crumble, even if the entire world turns to dust...
I will be here with you...
